source.text: וַיְהִ֕י כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר יָשַׁ֥ב דָּוִ֖יד בְּבֵית֑וֹ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜יד אֶל־נָתָ֣ן הַנָּבִ֗יא הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֤י יוֹשֵׁב֙ בְּבֵ֣ית הָֽאֲרָזִ֔ים וַאֲר֥וֹן בְּרִית־יְהוָ֖ה תַּ֥חַת יְרִיעֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was when sat David in his house, and said David to Nathan the prophet, See, I [am] dwelling in [the] house of the cedars, and [the] ark of [the] covenant of Yahweh [is] under curtains.

en.L: And it happened, when David was dwelling in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, "See, I am dwelling in a house of cedar, and the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] under curtains."
en.B: When David was settled in his house, he said to Nathan the prophet, "Look, I live in a house of cedar, but the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} stays under tent curtains."
en.R: King David was now living in his palace. He said to Nathan the prophet, "Look! I live in a palace made of cedar wood, but the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is kept in a tent."

es.L: Y sucedió que, cuando David habitaba en su casa, dijo David al profeta Natán: «Mira, yo habito en una casa de cedro, y el arca del pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} [está] bajo cortinas».
es.B: Cuando David ya estaba instalado en su casa, le dijo al profeta Natán: «Mira, yo vivo en una casa de cedro, pero el arca del pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} está bajo las cortinas de una tienda».
es.R: El rey David ya vivía en su palacio. Le dijo al profeta Natán: «¡Mira! Yo vivo en un palacio hecho de madera de cedro, pero el arca del pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} está en una tienda».

fr.L: Et il arriva, quand David habitait dans sa maison, que David dit à Nathan le prophète : « Vois : moi, j’habite dans une maison de cèdre, et l’arche de l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} [est] sous des tentures. »
fr.B: Lorsque David fut installé dans sa maison, il dit au prophète Nathan : « Regarde : j’habite une maison de cèdre, mais l’arche de l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} demeure sous des toiles de tente. »
fr.R: Le roi David habitait maintenant dans son palais. Il a dit au prophète Nathan : « Regarde ! J’habite dans un palais en bois de cèdre, mais l’arche de l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} est gardée sous une tente. »

sw.L: Ikawa Daudi alipokuwa akikaa katika nyumba yake, Daudi akamwambia Nathani nabii, "Tazama, mimi ninakaa katika nyumba ya mierezi, na sanduku la agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [liko] chini ya mapazia."
sw.B: Daudi alipokuwa ametulia katika nyumba yake, alimwambia Nathani nabii, "Tazama, mimi ninaishi katika nyumba ya mierezi, lakini sanduku la agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} linakaa chini ya mapazia ya hema."
sw.R: Sasa mfalme Daudi alikuwa akiishi katika jumba lake la kifalme. Akamwambia Nathani nabii, "Tazama! Mimi ninaishi katika jumba la kifalme lililojengwa kwa mbao za mierezi, lakini sanduku la agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} linawekwa ndani ya hema."

vi.L: Khi Đa-vít ở trong nhà mình, Đa-vít nói với nhà tiên tri Na-than: "Kìa, ta ở trong nhà bằng gỗ bá hương, còn hòm giao ước của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [ở] dưới các bức màn."
vi.B: Khi Đa-vít đã an cư trong cung mình, ông nói với nhà tiên tri Na-than: "Ông xem, ta ở trong cung điện bằng gỗ bá hương, còn hòm giao ước của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} lại ở dưới các tấm màn lều."
vi.R: Bấy giờ vua Đa-vít đang sống trong cung điện của mình. Vua nói với nhà tiên tri Na-than: "Ông xem! Ta ở trong cung điện làm bằng gỗ bá hương, còn hòm giao ước của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} lại ở trong một cái lều."

ko.L: 그리고 다윗이 자기 집에 살게 되었을 때, 다윗이 예언자 나단에게 말했다. "보아라, 나는 백향목 집에 살고 있는데, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 언약궤는 휘장 아래에 [있다]."
ko.B: 다윗이 자기 집에 자리를 잡았을 때, 예언자 나단에게 말했다. "보시오, 나는 백향목으로 지은 집에 사는데, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 언약궤는 아직도 천막 휘장 아래에 있소."
ko.R: 다윗 왕은 이제 자기 왕궁에서 살고 있었다. 그가 예언자 나단에게 말했다. "보시오! 나는 백향목으로 지은 왕궁에 사는데, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 언약궤는 천막 안에 있소."

pt.L: E aconteceu que, quando Davi habitava na sua casa, Davi disse ao profeta Natã: "Veja, eu habito numa casa de cedro, e a arca da aliança {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} [está] debaixo de cortinas."
pt.B: Quando Davi já estava instalado na sua casa, disse ao profeta Natã: "Veja, eu moro numa casa de cedro, mas a arca da aliança {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} fica debaixo das cortinas de uma tenda."
pt.R: O rei Davi agora morava no seu palácio. Ele disse ao profeta Natã: "Veja! Eu moro num palácio feito de madeira de cedro, mas a arca da aliança {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} fica numa tenda."

am.L: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ዳዊት በቤቱ በተቀመጠ ጊዜ፣ ዳዊት ነቢዩን ናታንን፦ «እነሆ፣ እኔ በዝግባ ቤት ተቀምጫለሁ፤ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} የቃል ኪዳን ታቦት ግን ከመጋረጃዎች በታች [ነው]» አለው።
am.B: ዳዊት በቤቱ ተደላድሎ በተቀመጠ ጊዜ ነቢዩን ናታንን፦ «ተመልከት፤ እኔ ከዝግባ በተሠራ ቤት እኖራለሁ፤ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} የቃል ኪዳን ታቦት ግን ከድንኳን መጋረጃዎች በታች ነው ያለው» አለው።
am.R: ንጉሥ ዳዊት አሁን በቤተ መንግሥቱ ይኖር ነበር። ነቢዩን ናታንንም፦ «ተመልከት! እኔ ከዝግባ እንጨት በተሠራ ቤተ መንግሥት እኖራለሁ፤ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} የቃል ኪዳን ታቦት ግን በድንኳን ውስጥ ተቀምጧል» አለው።

hi.L: और ऐसा हुआ कि जब दाऊद अपने घर में रहता था, तब दाऊद ने नातान भविष्यद्वक्ता से कहा, "देखिए, मैं देवदार के घर में रहता हूँ, और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की वाचा का संदूक परदों के नीचे [रहता है]।"
hi.B: जब दाऊद अपने घर में बस गया था, तब उसने नातान भविष्यद्वक्ता से कहा, "देखिए, मैं देवदार के घर में रहता हूँ, पर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की वाचा का संदूक तंबू के परदों के नीचे रहता है।"
hi.R: राजा दाऊद अब अपने महल में रहता था। उसने नातान नबी से कहा, "देखिए! मैं देवदार की लकड़ी से बने महल में रहता हूँ, पर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की वाचा का संदूक एक तंबू में रखा है।"

ru.L: И было: когда Давид жил в своём доме, сказал Давид пророку Нафану: «Смотри, я живу в доме из кедров, а ковчег завета {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} — под завесами.»
ru.B: Когда Давид поселился в своём доме, он сказал пророку Нафану: «Смотри, я живу в кедровом доме, а ковчег завета {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} стоит под завесами шатра.»
ru.R: Царь Давид теперь жил в своём дворце. Он сказал пророку Нафану: «Посмотри! Я живу во дворце из кедрового дерева, а ковчег завета {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} хранится в шатре.»

uk.L: І сталося, коли Давид жив у своєму домі, Давид сказав пророкові Натанові: «Ось я живу в кедровому домі, а ковчег заповіту {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНЬОГО|Ягве}} [перебуває] під завісами.»
uk.B: Коли Давид оселився у своєму домі, він сказав пророкові Натанові: «Дивися, я живу в кедровому домі, а ковчег заповіту {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНЬОГО|Ягве}} стоїть під наметовими завісами.»
uk.R: Цар Давид тепер жив у своєму палаці. Він сказав пророкові Натанові: «Поглянь! Я живу в палаці з кедрового дерева, а ковчег заповіту {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНЬОГО|Ягве}} стоїть у наметі.»

decisions.choice: his house: his royal palace
decisions.reason: The word means a house, a household or a family. Here it is the palace built for David of cedar sent by Hiram (14:1). The whole chapter turns on this word, as in 2 Samuel 7: David lives in a house (verse 1); he wants to build a house for Yahweh, that is, a temple (verses 4-6, 12); and Yahweh promises instead to build a house for David, a line of kings descended from him (verses 10, 23-25, 27).

decisions.choice: 1 Chronicles 17 retells 2 Samuel 7; here: David, the ark of the covenant, under curtains
decisions.reason: This chapter is the same account as 2 Samuel 7, and most of its words are the same. In this verse it differs in four ways. It names David where Samuel says "the king". It does not have Samuel's words that Yahweh had given him rest from all his enemies; in Chronicles David's wars come after this (chapters 18-20), and rest is promised to Solomon, "a man of rest" (22:9). It says "the ark of the covenant of Yahweh" where Samuel has "the ark of God". And the ark is "under curtains" where Samuel has "inside the curtain", that is, in a tent.

decisions.choice: a house of cedar: a costly royal building
decisions.reason: Cedar was a fine timber brought from Lebanon (14:1; 1 Kings 5:20). A house paneled with it was a mark of royal wealth (Jeremiah 22:14-15).

decisions.choice: curtains: the cloth of a tent
decisions.reason: The word names the cloths of a tent, its curtains or hangings (Exodus 26:1). The ark was kept in the tent David had pitched for it in Jerusalem (15:1; 16:1). The same verb is used for the king living in his house; David does not say what he plans, but the contrast makes it plain, and Nathan understands him (verse 2).

decisions.choice: house (Literal, Balanced); palace (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 7: Literal and Balanced keep the one word "house" all through the chapter so that the reader can follow the play on it (m1). Readable says "palace", "temple" or "family" where the sense is clear, and keeps "house" where the play itself is the point.

decisions.choice: under tent curtains (Balanced); in a tent (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced names the curtains as a tent's; Readable says simply "tent", which is what is meant (m4). Readable also says "King David" and starts a new sentence for his words.

decisions.choice: casa (L, B); palacio (R)
decisions.reason: As in the Spanish of 2 Samuel 7:1, which this chapter retells: the Hebrew "house" is the king's palace, said plainly at Readable.

decisions.choice: wording of 2 Samuel 7 reused; "sa maison" (L, B), "son palais" (R)
decisions.reason: This chapter retells 2 Samuel 7; the French of Samuel is kept wherever the Hebrew is the same, and changed only where Chronicles differs (here "David" for "the king", "the ark of the covenant of the LORD", "under curtains").

decisions.choice: The king says "ta" and "ông" to Nathan; Nathan calls David "vua"
decisions.reason: As the Vietnamese 2 Samuel 7, which this chapter retells; the king speaks to the prophet with respect but as king.

decisions.choice: the king speaks to Nathan in the plain style at Literal and in 하오체 at Balanced and Readable; Nathan answers in 합쇼체 with "임금님"
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 7:2-3, whose Korean wording this chapter keeps wherever Chronicles has the same Hebrew; "집" (house) is kept through the chapter at Literal and Balanced for the play on the word.

decisions.choice: as 2 Samuel 7:1-2: casa (L, B), palácio (R); a arca da aliança do SENHOR; debaixo de cortinas (L)
decisions.reason: The chapter keeps the Portuguese of 2 Samuel 7 at each level wherever the Hebrew is the same, and changes only what Chronicles changes (m2): here "Davi" for "o rei", no rest from his enemies, "a arca da aliança do SENHOR" for "a arca de Deus", and "debaixo de cortinas" for "no meio da cortina". As there, Literal and Balanced keep the one word "casa" all through the chapter for the play on it (m1), and Readable says "palácio", "templo" or "família" where the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of this chapter (17:4-27)
alternatives: deity_pronoun spans like the English ones
decisions.reason: Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalizes pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic.

decisions.choice: parallel 2 Samuel 7:1-2: its Amharic kept where the Hebrew agrees ("በቤቱ በተቀመጠ ጊዜ", "እነሆ፣ እኔ በዝግባ ቤት ተቀምጫለሁ", Readable as there), with Chronicles' "the ark of the covenant of the LORD" and "under curtains"
decisions.reason: Chronicles names David where Samuel says "the king", leaves out the rest from enemies (2 Samuel 7:1b), and has "the ark of the covenant of the LORD … under curtains" for "the ark of God … within the curtain".

decisions.choice: "घर" (Literal, Balanced); "महल" (Readable); "घराना" for the dynasty at Balanced
decisions.reason: This chapter retells 2 Samuel 7 (meaning m2) and keeps its Hindi wording at each level where the Hebrew is the same, including the play on "house": palace, temple and line of kings. Where the Hebrew differs (here David by name, the ark of the covenant of the LORD, curtains), the Hindi differs too.

decisions.choice: "आप" between David and Nathan ("देखिए"; Nathan: "आपके मन", "कीजिए")
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 7:2-3: the prophet says "आप" to the king and the king honours the prophet with "आप"; God says "तुम" to Nathan and to David, and David says "तू" when he prays.

decisions.choice: the Russian of 2 Samuel 7:1-2 where the Hebrew is the same; "дом" (Literal, Balanced), "дворец" (Readable)
decisions.reason: Chronicles leaves out the rest from enemies and says "David", "the ark of the covenant of the LORD" and "under curtains" (m2), so those words follow the Chronicles Hebrew; the rest keeps the Samuel wording at each level.

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר נָתָן֙ אֶל־דָּוִ֔יד כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּֽלְבָבְךָ֖ עֲשֵׂ֑ה כִּ֥י הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים עִמָּֽךְ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And said Nathan to David, All that [is] in your heart do, for the God [is] with you.

en.L: And Nathan said to David, "All that [is] in your heart, do [it], for God [is] with you."
en.B: Nathan said to David, "Do all that you have in mind, for God is with you."
en.R: Nathan answered David, "Do whatever you are planning, because God is with you."

es.L: Y dijo Natán a David: «Todo lo que [está] en tu corazón, haz[lo], porque Dios [está] contigo».
es.B: Natán le dijo a David: «Haz todo lo que tienes en mente, porque Dios está contigo».
es.R: Natán le respondió a David: «Haz lo que estás pensando, porque Dios está contigo».

fr.L: Et Nathan dit à David : « Tout ce qui [est] dans ton cœur, fais[-le], car Dieu [est] avec toi. »
fr.B: Nathan répondit à David : « Fais tout ce que tu as dans le cœur, car Dieu est avec toi. »
fr.R: Nathan a répondu à David : « Fais ce que tu as en projet, parce que Dieu est avec toi. »

sw.L: Nathani akamwambia Daudi, "Yote [yaliyo] moyoni mwako, fanya, kwa maana Mungu [yu] pamoja nawe."
sw.B: Nathani akamwambia Daudi, "Fanya yote uliyo nayo moyoni, kwa maana Mungu yu pamoja nawe."
sw.R: Nathani akamjibu Daudi, "Fanya lolote unalopanga, kwa sababu Mungu yu pamoja nawe."

vi.L: Na-than nói với Đa-vít: "Mọi điều [có] trong lòng vua, hãy làm [đi], vì Đức Chúa Trời ở cùng vua."
vi.B: Na-than thưa với Đa-vít: "Xin vua cứ làm mọi điều vua đã định trong lòng, vì Đức Chúa Trời ở cùng vua."
vi.R: Na-than trả lời Đa-vít: "Vua cứ làm bất cứ điều gì vua đang dự tính, vì Đức Chúa Trời ở cùng vua."

ko.L: 그리고 나단이 다윗에게 말했다. "임금님의 마음에 있는 모든 것을 하십시오. 하나님께서 임금님과 함께 [계십니다]."
ko.B: 나단이 다윗에게 말했다. "마음에 품으신 일을 무엇이든 하십시오. 하나님께서 임금님과 함께 계십니다."
ko.R: 나단이 다윗에게 대답했다. "계획하신 일을 무엇이든 그대로 하십시오. 하나님께서 임금님과 함께 계십니다."

pt.L: E Natã disse a Davi: "Tudo o que [está] no seu coração, faça, porque Deus [está] com você."
pt.B: Natã respondeu a Davi: "Faça tudo o que você tem em mente, pois Deus está com você."
pt.R: Natã respondeu a Davi: "Pode fazer o que você está planejando, porque Deus está com você."

am.L: ናታንም ዳዊትን፦ «እግዚአብሔር ከአንተ ጋር ነውና በልብህ ያለውን ሁሉ አድርግ» አለው።
am.B: ናታንም ዳዊትን፦ «እግዚአብሔር ከአንተ ጋር ስለ ሆነ በልብህ ያሰብከውን ሁሉ አድርግ» አለው።
am.R: ናታንም ዳዊትን፦ «እግዚአብሔር ከአንተ ጋር ስለ ሆነ ያሰብከውን ሁሉ አድርግ» ብሎ መለሰለት።

decisions.choice: all that is in your heart: all that you intend
decisions.reason: The heart is where a person thinks and plans, not only where he feels (1 Samuel 14:7).

decisions.choice: Nathan gives his own approval
decisions.reason: Nathan answers from his own judgment, without a word from Yahweh. That same night God speaks to him and turns David's plan another way (verses 3-6). Even a true prophet's own opinion is not the same as God's word.

decisions.choice: to David; do; God is with you
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 7:3 says "to the king", "go, do" and "Yahweh is with you". Chronicles has "to David", only "do", and "God" (literally "the God") in place of the name. Chronicles often says "God" where Samuel has the name Yahweh.

decisions.choice: whatever you are planning
decisions.reason: Readable puts the idiom of the heart in plain words.

decisions.choice: Mungu
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "God" where 2 Samuel 7:3 has "Yahweh"; the Swahili of Samuel changes only this word.

decisions.choice: você (Nathan to David); faça; Deus
decisions.reason: As 2 Samuel 7:3 in Portuguese, the prophet speaks to the king with "você". Chronicles has only "faça", without "vá", and "Deus" for the name (m3), so the wording changes there and nowhere else.

decisions.choice: Nathan speaks to David with "አንተ", here and in bringing God's word (verses 4-14)
alternatives: "እርስዎ", as a subject to the king
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 7 and the terms list: a prophet bringing God's word to a king says "አንተ".

decisions.choice: parallel 2 Samuel 7:3 copied, without "ሂድ" (go) and with "እግዚአብሔር" (God) for the name
decisions.reason: Chronicles has no "go" and says "God" (Elohim) where Samuel has the LORD; Elohim here is the one God, plain "እግዚአብሔር" outside the setting.

decisions.choice: no "иди", and "Бог" for "ГОСПОДЬ"
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 7:3 has "go" and "the LORD"; Chronicles has neither (m3), so the Samuel wording is kept without them.

decisions.choice: But that same night
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 7:4: the Hebrew joins the verse to what comes before with a plain "and". Balanced and Readable say "But", because God's word overturns Nathan's quick approval.

decisions.choice: my servant David: one who belongs to Yahweh and acts for him
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 7:5. The word is the one used for a slave, a person who belongs to a master. As a title from Yahweh it is an honor, given to Moses (Numbers 12:7) and to Joshua (Joshua 24:29).

decisions.choice: You shall not build: a plain statement, not a question
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 7:5 asks, "Will you build me a house for me to dwell in?", a question that expects the answer no. Chronicles says it outright: "You shall not build me the house to dwell in." It also says "the house", the one David has in mind, and "David my servant" in place of "my servant, David".

decisions.choice: not you: someone else will build it
decisions.reason: The word "you" is stressed. The house will be built, but by David's son (verse 12). 22:8 and 28:3 give the reason: David was a man of war who had shed much blood.

decisions.choice: the house to dwell in
decisions.reason: A temple was thought of as a god's dwelling. Yahweh does not refuse a house (verse 12), but he will not be housed at David's wish; Solomon himself says that the heavens cannot contain him (2 Chronicles 6:18).

decisions.choice: my slave (Literal); my servant (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 7:5 and the terms used for these books: Literal keeps the hard edge of the word, and Balanced and Readable say "servant", the usual sense of a title of honor (m1).

decisions.choice: Thus says the LORD (Literal); The LORD says this (Balanced); This is what the LORD says (Readable)
decisions.reason: The prophet's formula for introducing Yahweh's words keeps one wording at each level in these books.

decisions.choice: mi siervo David (siervo at every level)
decisions.reason: God's "my servant David" is "siervo" at every level, Literal included, as the Samuel and Kings notes settle, though the English Literal says "slave".

decisions.choice: Tú no me edificarás (a statement)
decisions.reason: Chronicles states it where 2 Samuel 7:5 asks a question, so the Spanish turns the question of Samuel into a plain statement and keeps its other words.

decisions.choice: "mon serviteur"
decisions.reason: The English Literal says "my slave"; French keeps "serviteur" at every level for God’s "my servant David", as the Samuel terms note settles, since the title is an honor.

decisions.choice: mtumishi wangu (every level)
decisions.reason: As in Samuel and Kings, God's "my servant David" is "mtumishi" at every level, Literal included, though the English Literal says "slave".

decisions.choice: BWANA asema hivi (L); Hivi ndivyo BWANA asemavyo (B); Hili ndilo BWANA analosema (R)
decisions.reason: The messenger formula keeps one wording per level, as in 2 Samuel 7:5. Chronicles states "you shall not build" where Samuel asks a question.

decisions.choice: "đầy tớ của Ta" (L), "đầy tớ Ta" (B, R)
decisions.reason: God's servant David is "đầy tớ" at every level, Literal included, as the Psalms note settles for a named servant of God; the English Literal's "slave" is not followed here.

decisions.choice: God calls David "ngươi" (L) and "con" (B, R), and says "Ta"
decisions.reason: As the Vietnamese 2 Samuel 7 and the Genesis note.

decisions.choice: "내 종 다윗"; "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다" (L), "이렇게 말씀하신다" (B), "이것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이다" (R)
decisions.reason: The Samuel note's wording for God's servant and for *koh amar YHWH*. Chronicles has "You shall not build" where 2 Samuel 7:5 asks "Will you build?", so the Korean is a statement.

decisions.choice: tu; o meu escravo (L), o meu servo (B, R); Assim diz o SENHOR (L, B), É isto o que diz o SENHOR (R)
decisions.reason: As 2 Samuel 7:5 in Portuguese: God speaks to Nathan and, through him, to David with "tu"; "escravo" at Literal and "servo" at Balanced and Readable; the prophet's formula in the words of each level. Where Samuel asks a question, Chronicles states it (m2), so every level says "Não és tu quem...", with the stress on "tu" (m3).

decisions.choice: parallel 2 Samuel 7:5: the messenger formula and "ባሪያዬ" / "አገልጋዬ" kept; the question "የምትሠራልኝ አንተ ነህን?" becomes the statement "የምትሠራልኝ አንተ አይደለህም"
decisions.reason: Chronicles states "You shall not build me the house" where Samuel asks "Will you build me a house?" (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun span; "मेरे", "मेरे लिए" for God
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change and the Hindi has no deity_pronoun spans (style guide, section 7). Respect for God is carried by the honorific third person in the narrative and by "तू" in prayer. This holds wherever the English has such a span in this chapter.

decisions.choice: a statement ("तुम ... नहीं बनाओगे"), not the question of 2 Samuel 7:5; "मेरे दास" at every level
decisions.reason: Here the Hebrew says plainly "you shall not build" (meanings m2, m3), so the Hindi does too. "दास" stays at every level for the servant of the LORD, as in 2 Samuel 7 and the Pentateuch note.

decisions.choice: "Не ты построишь", a statement
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 7:5 asks a question; Chronicles says it outright (m2), and the stress falls on "you": someone else will build it (m3).

source.text: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יָשַׁ֨בְתִּי֙ בְּבַ֔יִת מִן־הַיּ֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֶעֱלֵ֨יתִי֙ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַ֖ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וָֽאֶהְיֶ֛ה מֵאֹ֥הֶל אֶל־אֹ֖הֶל וּמִמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: For not I have dwelt in a house from the day that I brought up Israel until the day the this, and I have been from tent to tent and from tabernacle.

en.L: For I have not dwelt in a house from the day that I brought up Israel until this day, but I have been from tent to tent and from tabernacle [to tabernacle].
en.B: I have not lived in a house from the day I brought Israel up until this day. I have moved from one tent to another and from one tabernacle to another.
en.R: I have not lived in a house since the day I brought Israel up out of Egypt. All this time I have moved from one tent to another, from one tabernacle to another.

es.L: Porque no he habitado en casa desde el día en que hice subir a Israel hasta este día, sino que he estado de tienda en tienda y de tabernáculo [en tabernáculo].
es.B: No he vivido en una casa desde el día en que hice subir a Israel hasta el día de hoy. He andado de una tienda a otra y de un tabernáculo a otro.
es.R: No he vivido en una casa desde el día en que saqué a Israel de Egipto. Todo este tiempo he ido de una tienda a otra, de un tabernáculo a otro.

fr.L: Car je n’ai pas habité dans une maison depuis le jour où j’ai fait monter Israël jusqu’à ce jour, mais j’ai été de tente en tente et de demeure [en demeure].
fr.B: Je n’ai pas habité de maison depuis le jour où j’ai fait monter Israël jusqu’à aujourd’hui. Je suis allé d’une tente à l’autre, d’une demeure à l’autre.
fr.R: Je n’ai pas habité dans une maison depuis le jour où j’ai fait sortir Israël d’Égypte. Pendant tout ce temps, je suis allé d’une tente à l’autre, d’un sanctuaire à l’autre.

sw.L: Kwa maana sijakaa katika nyumba tangu siku nilipowapandisha Israeli mpaka siku hii ya leo, bali nimekuwa kutoka hema hadi hema, na kutoka maskani [hadi maskani].
sw.B: Sijaishi katika nyumba tangu siku nilipowapandisha Israeli mpaka leo. Nimekuwa nikihama kutoka hema moja hadi jingine, na kutoka maskani moja hadi nyingine.
sw.R: Sijaishi katika nyumba tangu siku nilipowatoa Waisraeli Misri. Muda wote huu nimekuwa nikihama kutoka hema moja hadi jingine, kutoka maskani moja hadi nyingine.

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã không ở trong nhà từ ngày {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đem Y-sơ-ra-ên lên cho đến ngày nay, nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đi từ lều này đến lều kia, từ đền tạm [này đến đền tạm khác].
vi.B: Ta không ở trong nhà từ ngày {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đem Y-sơ-ra-ên lên cho đến ngày nay. Ta đã đi từ lều này sang lều khác, từ đền tạm này sang đền tạm khác.
vi.R: Từ ngày {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đem dân Y-sơ-ra-ên ra khỏi Ai Cập, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chưa hề ở trong nhà. Suốt thời gian ấy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đi từ lều này sang lều khác, từ đền tạm này sang đền tạm khác.

ko.L: 나는 이스라엘을 올라오게 한 날부터 오늘까지 집에 살지 않았고, 장막에서 장막으로, 성막에서 [성막으로 옮겨 다녔다].
ko.B: 나는 이스라엘을 이끌어 올린 날부터 오늘까지 집에서 산 적이 없다. 나는 이 장막에서 저 장막으로, 이 성막에서 저 성막으로 옮겨 다녔다.
ko.R: 나는 이스라엘을 이집트에서 데리고 나온 날부터 집에서 살지 않았다. 그동안 나는 이 천막 저 천막으로, 이 성막 저 성막으로 옮겨 다녔다.

pt.L: Porque não habitei numa casa desde o dia em que fiz subir Israel até este dia, mas tenho estado de tenda em tenda e de tabernáculo [em tabernáculo].
pt.B: Não morei numa casa desde o dia em que fiz Israel subir até hoje. Tenho andado de uma tenda para outra e de um tabernáculo para outro.
pt.R: Eu não morei numa casa desde o dia em que tirei Israel do Egito. Todo esse tempo andei de uma tenda para outra, de um tabernáculo para outro.

am.L: እስራኤልን ካወጣሁበት ቀን ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ በቤት አልተቀመጥኩምና፤ ነገር ግን ከድንኳን ወደ ድንኳን፣ ከማደሪያም [ወደ ማደሪያ] ነበርኩ።
am.B: እስራኤልን ካወጣሁበት ቀን ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ በቤት ውስጥ አልኖርኩም። ከአንዱ ድንኳን ወደ ሌላው ድንኳን፣ ከአንዱ ማደሪያ ወደ ሌላው ማደሪያ እዘዋወር ነበር።
am.R: እስራኤልን ከግብፅ ካወጣሁበት ቀን ጀምሮ በቤት ውስጥ አልኖርኩም። በዚህ ጊዜ ሁሉ ከአንዱ ድንኳን ወደ ሌላው፣ ከአንዱ ማደሪያ ወደ ሌላው ተዘዋወርኩ።

hi.L: क्योंकि जिस दिन मैं इस्राएल को निकाल ले आया, उस दिन से आज के दिन तक मैं किसी घर में नहीं रहा, बल्कि एक तंबू से दूसरे तंबू में और एक निवास-तंबू से [दूसरे निवास-तंबू में] रहा हूँ।
hi.B: जिस दिन मैं इस्राएल को निकाल ले आया, उस दिन से आज तक मैं किसी घर में नहीं रहा। मैं एक तंबू से दूसरे तंबू में, और एक पवित्र तंबू से दूसरे पवित्र तंबू में जाता रहा हूँ।
hi.R: जिस दिन मैं इस्राएल को मिस्र से निकाल ले आया, तब से मैं किसी घर में नहीं रहा। इतने समय तक मैं एक तंबू से दूसरे तंबू में, एक पवित्र तंबू से दूसरे पवित्र तंबू में जाता रहा हूँ।

ru.L: Ведь {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не жил в доме со дня, когда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} вывел Израиль, и до этого дня, а {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} был от шатра к шатру и от скинии [к скинии].
ru.B: Я не жил в доме с того дня, как вывел Израиль, и по сей день. Я переходил из шатра в шатёр и из одной скинии в другую.
ru.R: Я не жил в доме с того дня, как вывел Израиль из Египта. Всё это время {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} переходил из одного шатра в другой, из одного священного шатра в другой.

uk.L: Бо Я не жив у домі від дня, коли вивів Ізраїля, аж до цього дня, але був від намету до намету і від скинії [до скинії].
uk.B: Я не жив у домі від того дня, коли вивів Ізраїля, аж до цього дня. Я переходив з одного намету до іншого, з однієї скинії до іншої.
uk.R: Я не жив у домі від того дня, коли вивів Ізраїля з Єгипту. Увесь цей час Я переходив з одного намету до іншого, з однієї скинії до іншої.

decisions.choice: from tent to tent and from tabernacle [to tabernacle]: from one place to another
alternatives: from tent to tent and from a tabernacle (as the words stand)
decisions.reason: The words are short: "from tent to tent and from tabernacle". The second pair is taken to follow the pattern of the first, so that Yahweh's dwelling moved from place to place. The sanctuary stood at Shiloh (Joshua 18:1) and later at Gibeon (16:39; 21:29), while the ark was kept in other places and at last in a tent in Jerusalem (13:13-14; 16:1).

decisions.choice: I brought up Israel; from tent to tent
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 7:6 says "I brought up the sons of Israel from Egypt" and "I have been going about in a tent and in a tabernacle". Chronicles says "I brought up Israel", without "from Egypt", and "I have been from tent to tent and from tabernacle".

decisions.choice: tent ... tabernacle: the portable sanctuary
decisions.reason: Both words name the sanctuary made in the wilderness: "tent" for its covering and "tabernacle", which means dwelling place, for the place where Yahweh dwelt among his people (Exodus 26:1, 7; 40:34-35).

decisions.choice: [to tabernacle] (Literal); from one tabernacle to another (Balanced)
decisions.reason: Literal supplies the words the short phrase implies (m1); Balanced and Readable say it as one movement from place to place.

decisions.choice: brought Israel up out of Egypt
decisions.reason: Readable says where Yahweh brought Israel up from, as 2 Samuel 7:6 does, and leaves out "until this day", which "all this time" covers.

decisions.choice: fiz subir Israel (L, B), without "do Egito"; de tenda em tenda e de tabernáculo [em tabernáculo]
decisions.reason: Chronicles says only "I brought up Israel" (m2), so Literal and Balanced leave out the "do Egito" of 2 Samuel 7:6 in Portuguese; Readable names Egypt, as the English Readable does. The short Hebrew phrase is completed in brackets at Literal (m1).

decisions.choice: parallel 2 Samuel 7:6: "ካወጣሁበት ቀን ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ በቤት አልተቀመጥኩምና" kept; "from tent to tent and from tabernacle" follows Chronicles
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "Israel" without "the sons of" and "from Egypt", and "from tent to tent and from tabernacle" for "moving about in a tent and in a tabernacle"; Literal brackets the unspoken "to tabernacle", as the English.

source.text: בְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶֽׁר־הִתְהַלַּכְתִּי֮ בְּכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ הֲדָבָ֣ר דִּבַּ֗רְתִּי אֶת־אַחַד֙ שֹׁפְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֛יתִי לִרְע֥וֹת אֶת־עַמִּ֖י לֵאמֹ֑ר לָ֛מָּה לֹא־בְנִיתֶ֥ם לִ֖י בֵּ֥ית אֲרָזִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: In all where I have gone about among all Israel, [did] a word I speak with one of [the] judges of Israel whom I commanded to shepherd my people, saying, Why not have you built for me a house of cedars?

en.L: In all [places] where I have moved about among all Israel, did I speak a word with one of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to shepherd {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people, saying, "Why have you not built {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} a house of cedar?"'
en.B: Wherever I have moved about among all Israel, did I ever say a word to any of the judges of Israel that I commanded to shepherd {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people, asking, "Why have you not built {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} a house of cedar?"'
en.R: In all the places I went with the people of Israel, I never said to any of Israel's judges, whom I told to care for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people like a shepherd, "Why have you not built {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} a house made of cedar?"'

es.L: En todo [lugar] por donde he andado con todo Israel, ¿hablé yo palabra a alguno de los jueces de Israel, a quienes mandé pastorear a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo, diciendo: ‘¿Por qué no me han edificado una casa de cedro?’?”.
es.B: Dondequiera que he andado entre todo Israel, ¿dije alguna vez una palabra a alguno de los jueces de Israel a quienes mandé pastorear a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo, preguntando: ‘¿Por qué no me han construido una casa de cedro?’?”.
es.R: En todos los lugares adonde fui con el pueblo de Israel, nunca les dije a los jueces de Israel, a quienes mandé cuidar de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo como un pastor: ‘¿Por qué no me han construido una casa de cedro?’”.

fr.L: Partout où j’ai circulé parmi tout Israël, ai-je dit un mot à l’un des juges d’Israël à qui j’avais commandé de faire paître {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, en disant : ‘Pourquoi ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez-vous pas bâti une maison de cèdre ?’”
fr.B: Partout où je me suis déplacé parmi tout Israël, ai-je jamais dit un mot à l’un des juges d’Israël que j’avais chargés de faire paître {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, pour lui demander : ‘Pourquoi ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez-vous pas bâti une maison de cèdre ?’”
fr.R: Dans tous les endroits où je suis allé avec le peuple d’Israël, je n’ai jamais dit à aucun des juges d’Israël, que j’avais chargés de prendre soin de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple comme un berger : ‘Pourquoi ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez-vous pas construit une maison en cèdre ?’”

sw.L: Katika [mahali] pote nilipotembea kati ya Israeli wote, je, nilisema neno na mmoja wa waamuzi wa Israeli, niliowaamuru kuwachunga watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, nikisema, "Kwa nini hamjanijengea nyumba ya mierezi?"'
sw.B: Popote nilipotembea kati ya Israeli wote, je, niliwahi kusema neno na yeyote wa waamuzi wa Israeli niliowaamuru kuwachunga watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, nikiuliza, "Kwa nini hamjanijengea nyumba ya mierezi?"'
sw.R: Katika mahali pote nilipokwenda pamoja na Waisraeli, sikuwahi kumwambia yeyote wa waamuzi wa Israeli, niliowaagiza kuwatunza watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} kama mchungaji, "Kwa nini hamjanijengea nyumba ya mierezi?"'

vi.L: Ở mọi nơi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đi giữa toàn thể Y-sơ-ra-ên, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} có nói một lời nào với một trong các quan xét Y-sơ-ra-ên, là những người {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã truyền chăn dắt dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, rằng: "Sao các ngươi không xây cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} một ngôi nhà bằng gỗ bá hương?" không?'
vi.B: Ở bất cứ nơi nào {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đi cùng toàn dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, có bao giờ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với một quan xét nào của Y-sơ-ra-ên, là những người {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã truyền chăn dắt dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, rằng: "Sao các ngươi không xây cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} một ngôi nhà bằng gỗ bá hương?" không?'
vi.R: Ở mọi nơi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đi cùng dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chưa hề nói với một thủ lĩnh nào của Y-sơ-ra-ên, là những người {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã bảo phải chăm sóc dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} như người chăn chiên: "Sao các ngươi không xây cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} một ngôi nhà bằng gỗ bá hương?"'

ko.L: 내가 온 이스라엘 가운데 옮겨 다닌 모든 곳에서, 내가 내 백성을 목자로서 돌보라고 명령한 이스라엘의 사사들 가운데 어느 하나에게 '어찌하여 너희는 나를 위하여 백향목 집을 짓지 않았느냐?' 하고 한마디라도 말한 적이 있느냐?'
ko.B: 내가 온 이스라엘과 함께 옮겨 다닌 모든 곳에서, 내 백성을 목자처럼 돌보라고 명령한 이스라엘의 사사들 가운데 누구에게라도 '왜 나에게 백향목 집을 지어 주지 않느냐?' 하고 말한 적이 있느냐?'
ko.R: 나는 이스라엘 백성과 함께 여러 곳을 다녔다. 나는 이스라엘의 사사들에게 내 백성을 목자처럼 돌보라고 명령했다. 그러나 그 가운데 누구에게도 '왜 나에게 백향목으로 집을 지어 주지 않느냐?' 하고 말한 적이 없다.'

pt.L: Em todos [os lugares] por onde andei entre todo o Israel, falei eu alguma palavra a algum dos juízes de Israel, a quem ordenei que apascentasse o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo, dizendo: "Por que vocês não {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} edificaram uma casa de cedro?"'
pt.B: Por onde quer que eu tenha andado com todo o Israel, alguma vez eu disse uma palavra sequer a algum dos juízes de Israel a quem ordenei que apascentasse o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo, perguntando: "Por que vocês não {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} construíram uma casa de cedro?"'
pt.R: Em todos os lugares por onde andei com o povo de Israel, eu nunca disse a nenhum dos juízes de Israel, a quem mandei cuidar do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo como um pastor: "Por que vocês não {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} construíram uma casa feita de cedro?"'

am.L: ከእስራኤል ሁሉ ጋር በተዘዋወርኩበት ስፍራ ሁሉ ሕዝቤን እንዲጠብቁ ካዘዝኋቸው ከእስራኤል መሳፍንት ለአንዱ፦ ‘የዝግባ ቤት ስለ ምን አልሠራችሁልኝም?’ ብዬ ቃል ተናግሬአለሁን?”
am.B: ከእስራኤል ሁሉ ጋር በተዘዋወርኩበት ስፍራ ሁሉ ሕዝቤን እንዲጠብቁ ካዘዝኋቸው ከእስራኤል መሳፍንት ለአንዱ እንኳ፦ ‘ከዝግባ የተሠራ ቤት ለምን አልሠራችሁልኝም?’ ብዬ ጠይቄ አውቃለሁን?”
am.R: ከእስራኤል ሕዝብ ጋር በሄድኩባቸው ስፍራዎች ሁሉ ሕዝቤን እንደ እረኛ እንዲጠብቁ ካዘዝኋቸው ከእስራኤል መሪዎች ለአንዱም፦ ‘ከዝግባ እንጨት የተሠራ ቤት ለምን አልሠራችሁልኝም?’ ብዬ አላውቅም።”

hi.L: जहाँ-जहाँ मैं सारे इस्राएल के बीच घूमता-फिरता रहा, क्या मैंने इस्राएल के न्यायियों में से किसी एक से, जिसे मैंने अपनी प्रजा की चरवाही करने की आज्ञा दी थी, कभी एक बात भी कही, कि "तुमने मेरे लिए देवदार का घर क्यों नहीं बनाया?"'
hi.B: जहाँ-जहाँ मैं सारे इस्राएल के बीच घूमता रहा, क्या मैंने इस्राएल के उन न्यायियों में से किसी से, जिन्हें मैंने अपनी प्रजा की चरवाही करने की आज्ञा दी थी, कभी यह कहा, "तुमने मेरे लिए देवदार का घर क्यों नहीं बनाया?"'
hi.R: इस्राएल के लोगों के साथ मैं जहाँ-जहाँ गया, वहाँ मैंने इस्राएल के किसी न्यायी से, जिसे मैंने अपनी प्रजा की चरवाहे की तरह देखभाल करने को कहा था, कभी नहीं कहा, "तुमने मेरे लिए देवदार की लकड़ी का घर क्यों नहीं बनाया?"'

ru.L: Во всех [местах], где {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} ходил среди всего Израиля, сказал ли {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} слово хоть одному из судей Израиля, которым {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} повелел пасти {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ, говоря: ‘Почему вы не построили {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}} дома из кедров?’”
ru.B: Где бы {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} ни ходил среди всего Израиля, сказал ли {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} хоть слово кому-нибудь из судей Израиля, которым {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} велел пасти {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ: ‘Почему вы не построили {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}} кедрового дома?’”
ru.R: Во всех местах, куда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} ходил с израильтянами, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} ни разу не сказал ни одному из судей Израиля, которым {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} велел заботиться о {{deity_pronoun:моём|Моём}} народе, как пастух о стаде: ‘Почему вы не построили {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}} дом из кедра?’”

uk.L: Скрізь, де Я ходив серед усього Ізраїля, чи сказав Я хоч слово комусь із суддів Ізраїля, яким Я наказав пасти {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} народ, кажучи: ‘Чому ви не збудували {{deity_pronoun:мені|Мені}} кедрового дому?’”
uk.B: Скрізь, де Я ходив серед усього Ізраїля, чи сказав Я хоч слово комусь із суддів Ізраїля, яким Я наказав пасти {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} народ, питаючи: ‘Чому ви не збудували {{deity_pronoun:мені|Мені}} кедрового дому?’”
uk.R: Усюди, куди Я ходив з ізраїльтянами, Я ніколи не казав жодному із суддів Ізраїля, яким Я доручив дбати про {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} народ, як пастух: ‘Чому ви не збудували {{deity_pronoun:мені|Мені}} дому з кедрового дерева?’”

decisions.choice: judges: the leaders Yahweh appointed
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 7:7 has "one of the tribes of Israel"; Chronicles has "one of the judges of Israel", a word that differs by one letter. "Judges" fits the words that follow, "whom I commanded to shepherd my people", and verse 10 also speaks of judges. Chronicles also says "among all Israel" for "among all the sons of Israel", and "my people" without "Israel".

decisions.choice: to shepherd: to lead and care for
decisions.reason: Shepherding is a common picture of ruling a people: guiding, feeding and protecting them (11:2; Numbers 27:17).

decisions.choice: did I speak a word ...?: I never said this
decisions.reason: The question expects the answer no: Yahweh never asked any of Israel's leaders for a house of cedar.

decisions.choice: judges: Israel's leaders before the kings
decisions.reason: The judges were the leaders Yahweh raised up to rescue Israel from its enemies, from after Joshua to Samuel (Judges 2:16-18; 1 Samuel 7:15).

decisions.choice: I never said to any of Israel's judges
decisions.reason: Readable turns the question into the statement it implies, and says "the people of Israel" for "all Israel".

decisions.choice: waamuzi wa Israeli
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "the judges of Israel" where 2 Samuel 7:7 has "the tribes"; the Swahili of Samuel changes only this word.

decisions.choice: "quan xét" (Literal, Balanced); "thủ lĩnh" (Readable)
decisions.reason: Chronicles reads "judges" where 2 Samuel 7:7 has "tribes"; the word follows Joshua–Ruth: "quan xét" (Literal, Balanced), the name of the office in Judges and Acts 13:20, and "thủ lĩnh" (Readable); "thẩm phán" would suggest a law court.

decisions.choice: "사사들"
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "the judges of Israel" where 2 Samuel 7:7 has "the tribes"; "사사" is the Korean name of Israel's judges, as in 2 Samuel 7:11.

decisions.choice: os juízes de Israel
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 7:7 in Portuguese at each level, with "juízes" where Samuel has "tribos" (m1), and "todo o Israel" (L, B) for Chronicles' "all Israel".

decisions.choice: parallel 2 Samuel 7:7 copied, with "judges" for Samuel's "tribes": "መሳፍንት" (Literal, Balanced), "መሪዎች" (Readable)
decisions.reason: Chronicles reads "judges" (shofetim), "all Israel" and "my people"; the shofetim are given as the terms list gives the leaders of Judges, as 2 Samuel 7:11.

decisions.choice: "न्यायियों" (judges)
decisions.reason: Where 2 Samuel 7:7 has "tribes", Chronicles has "judges" (meanings m1, m4), so the Hindi says "न्यायी", the history-books note's word, and otherwise keeps the wording of 2 Samuel 7:7.

decisions.choice: "судей"
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 7:7 has "tribes"; the Chronicles Hebrew has "judges" (m4), so the Russian differs there and keeps the Samuel wording elsewhere.

source.text: וְ֠עַתָּה כֹּֽה־תֹאמַ֞ר לְעַבְדִּ֣י לְדָוִ֗ידסכֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת אֲנִ֤י לְקַחְתִּ֨יךָ֙ מִן־הַנָּוֶ֔ה מִֽן־אַחֲרֵ֖י הַצֹּ֑אן לִהְי֣וֹת נָגִ֔יד עַ֖ל עַמִּ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And now thus you will say to my servant, to David, Thus says Yahweh of hosts, I took you from the pasture, from after the flock, to be ruler over my people Israel.

en.L: And now, thus you shall say to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} slave, to David, 'Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts: I took you from the pasture, from following the flock, to be ruler over {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel.
en.B: Now then, say this to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant David: '{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies says this: I took you from the pasture, from following the sheep, to be ruler over {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel.
en.R: So now, tell {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant David, 'This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies says: I took you from the fields where you followed the sheep, and I made you leader of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel.

es.L: Y ahora, así dirás a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo, a David: “Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos: Yo te tomé del pastizal, de detrás del rebaño, para que fueras gobernante sobre {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel.
es.B: Ahora pues, dile a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo David: “{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos dice esto: Yo te tomé del pastizal, de ir detrás de las ovejas, para que fueras gobernante sobre {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel.
es.R: Así que ahora dile a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo David: “Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos: Yo te saqué de los campos donde ibas detrás de las ovejas, y te hice líder de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel.

fr.L: Et maintenant, tu diras ainsi à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur, à David : “Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées : Moi, je t’ai pris au pâturage, derrière le troupeau, pour que tu sois chef sur {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël.
fr.B: Maintenant donc, voici ce que tu diras à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur David : “{{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées dit ceci : Je t’ai pris au pâturage, derrière les moutons, pour que tu sois chef sur {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël.
fr.R: Alors maintenant, dis à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur David : “Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées : Je t’ai pris dans les champs où tu suivais les moutons, et j’ai fait de toi le chef de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël.

sw.L: Basi sasa, hivi utamwambia mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, Daudi, '{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asema hivi: Mimi nilikutwaa kutoka malishoni, kutoka kufuata kondoo, uwe kiongozi juu ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli.
sw.B: Basi sasa, mwambie mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Daudi hivi: 'Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asemavyo: Nilikutwaa kutoka malishoni, ulipokuwa ukifuata kondoo, uwe kiongozi juu ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli.
sw.R: Basi sasa, mwambie mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Daudi, 'Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi analosema: Nilikutoa malishoni ulikokuwa ukichunga kondoo, nikakufanya kiongozi wa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli.

vi.L: Vậy bây giờ, ngươi hãy nói thế này với đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, với Đa-vít: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán thế này: Ta đã đem ngươi ra từ đồng cỏ, từ việc đi theo bầy chiên, để làm người lãnh đạo dân Y-sơ-ra-ên của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.B: Vậy bây giờ, hãy nói với Đa-vít, đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán như vầy: Ta đã đem con ra từ đồng cỏ, từ chỗ đi theo bầy chiên, để làm người lãnh đạo dân Y-sơ-ra-ên của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.R: Vậy bây giờ, hãy nói với Đa-vít, đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}: 'Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán: Ta đã đem con ra từ đồng cỏ, nơi con chăn chiên, và lập con làm người lãnh đạo dân Y-sơ-ra-ên của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

ko.L: 그러니 이제 너는 내 종, 다윗에게 이렇게 말하여라. '만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 내가 너를 목장에서, 양 떼를 따르던 데서 데려다가 내 백성 이스라엘의 지도자가 되게 하였다.
ko.B: 그러니 이제 내 종 다윗에게 이렇게 말하여라. '만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 나는 양 떼를 따라다니던 너를 목장에서 데려다가 내 백성 이스라엘의 지도자로 세웠다.
ko.R: 그러니 이제 내 종 다윗에게 말하여라. '이것은 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이다. 너는 들판에서 양 떼를 따라다녔는데, 내가 너를 데려다가 내 백성 이스라엘의 지도자로 세웠다.

pt.L: E agora, assim dirás ao {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} escravo, a Davi: 'Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos: Eu te tomei do pasto, de trás do rebanho, para seres príncipe sobre o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo Israel.
pt.B: Agora, pois, dize isto ao {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} servo Davi: 'Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos: Eu te tirei do pasto, de detrás das ovelhas, para que fosses príncipe sobre o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo Israel.
pt.R: Agora, dize ao {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} servo Davi: 'É isto o que diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos: Eu te tirei dos campos onde seguias as ovelhas e te fiz chefe do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo Israel.

am.L: አሁንም ለባሪያዬ ለዳዊት እንዲህ በለው፦ “{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸባኦት እንዲህ ይላል፦ በሕዝቤ በእስራኤል ላይ ገዥ ትሆን ዘንድ ከመሰማሪያው፣ በጎችን ከመከተል ወሰድኩህ።
am.B: እንግዲህ አሁን ለአገልጋዬ ለዳዊት እንዲህ በለው፦ “የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ በሕዝቤ በእስራኤል ላይ ገዥ እንድትሆን በጎችን ከምትከተልበት ከመሰማሪያው ወሰድኩህ።
am.R: ስለዚህ አሁን ለአገልጋዬ ለዳዊት እንዲህ በለው፦ “የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የሚለው ይህ ነው፦ በጎችን ትከተልበት ከነበረው መስክ ወሰድኩህ፤ የሕዝቤ የእስራኤልም መሪ አደረግሁህ።

hi.L: और अब, तुम मेरे दास से, दाऊद से, यों कहना, 'सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यों कहते हैं: मैंने तुम्हें चरागाह से, भेड़-बकरियों के पीछे-पीछे चलने से, लिया, ताकि तुम मेरी प्रजा इस्राएल पर प्रधान हो।
hi.B: इसलिए अब मेरे दास दाऊद से यह कहना: 'सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: मैंने तुम्हें चरागाह से, भेड़ों के पीछे चलने से, लिया, ताकि तुम मेरी प्रजा इस्राएल पर प्रधान बनो।
hi.R: इसलिए अब मेरे दास दाऊद से कहो, 'सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: तुम मैदानों में भेड़ों के पीछे चलते थे, और मैंने तुम्हें वहाँ से लेकर अपनी प्रजा इस्राएल का अगुवा बनाया।

ru.L: И теперь так скажи {{deity_pronoun:моему|Моему}} рабу, Давиду: “Так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф: Я взял тебя с пастбища, от [хождения] за стадом, чтобы ты был правителем над {{deity_pronoun:моим|Моим}} народом Израилем.
ru.B: А теперь скажи {{deity_pronoun:моему|Моему}} рабу Давиду: “{{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф говорит так: Я взял тебя с пастбища, от овец, чтобы ты был правителем над {{deity_pronoun:моим|Моим}} народом Израилем.
ru.R: Так вот, скажи {{deity_pronoun:моему|Моему}} рабу Давиду: “Вот что говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Воинств: Я взял тебя с полей, где ты ходил за овцами, и сделал тебя вождём {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} народа Израиля.

uk.L: А тепер так скажеш {{deity_pronoun:моєму|Моєму}} рабові, Давидові: “Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Саваот: Я взяв тебе з пасовища, від отари, щоб ти був правителем над {{deity_pronoun:моїм|Моїм}} народом Ізраїлем.
uk.B: Тож скажи {{deity_pronoun:моєму|Моєму}} рабові Давидові: “Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Небесних Військ: Я взяв тебе з пасовища, де ти ходив за вівцями, щоб ти був правителем над {{deity_pronoun:моїм|Моїм}} народом Ізраїлем.
uk.R: Тож тепер скажи {{deity_pronoun:моєму|Моєму}} рабові Давидові: “Ось що говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Вседержитель: Я взяв тебе з полів, де ти ходив за вівцями, і зробив тебе провідником {{deity_pronoun:мого|Мого}} народу Ізраїлю.

decisions.choice: Yahweh of hosts: Yahweh, commander of armies
decisions.reason: "Hosts" means armies: the armies of Israel and the powers of heaven, all under Yahweh's command (1 Samuel 1:3; 17:45).

decisions.choice: from the pasture, from following the flock
decisions.reason: David was a shepherd boy when Samuel anointed him (1 Samuel 16:11; 17:15, 34). Yahweh took the one who shepherded sheep to shepherd his people (verse 6; 11:2; Psalm 78:70-71). The verse is the same as 2 Samuel 7:8, except that it says "over my people Israel" where Samuel has "over my people, over Israel".

decisions.choice: ruler: the leader Yahweh appoints over his people
decisions.reason: The word names a leader chosen by Yahweh to rule his people for him. It was used of Saul (1 Samuel 9:16; 10:1) and of David (11:2; 1 Samuel 13:14).

decisions.choice: the LORD of hosts (Literal); the LORD of Armies (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As in the terms used for these books. "Armies" says in today's English what "hosts" means.

decisions.choice: leader
decisions.reason: Readable says "leader" for the word for ruler, as in the terms used for these books.

decisions.choice: o SENHOR dos Exércitos (every level); príncipe (L, B), chefe (R)
decisions.reason: As 2 Samuel 7:8 in Portuguese: "Exércitos" at every level, where the English Literal keeps "hosts", and "príncipe" / "chefe" for the leader the LORD appoints (m3). Literal says "sobre o meu povo Israel", as Chronicles has it (m2).

decisions.choice: parallel 2 Samuel 7:8 copied at every level; YHWH Tsevaot is "{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸባኦት" (Literal), "የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is the same but for a spelling of "from after" and "over my people Israel"; "ጸባኦት" is the Hebrew word for "armies", kept at Literal, as the terms list has it.

decisions.choice: "ГОСПОДЬ Саваоф" (Literal, Balanced); "ГОСПОДЬ Воинств" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The history note's forms for the LORD of hosts, as in 2 Samuel 7:8.

source.text: וָֽאֶהְיֶ֣ה עִמְּךָ֗ בְּכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָלַ֔כְתָּ וָאַכְרִ֥ית אֶת־כָּל־אוֹיְבֶ֖יךָ מִפָּנֶ֑יךָ וְעָשִׂ֤יתִֽי לְךָ֙ שֵׁ֔ם כְּשֵׁ֥ם הַגְּדוֹלִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: And I have been with you in all where you went, and I cut off all your enemies from before you, and I will make for you a name like [the] name of the great [ones] who [are] on the earth.

en.L: And I have been with you wherever you went, and I have cut off all your enemies from before you, and I will make for you a name like the name of the great ones who [are] on the earth.
en.B: Wherever you have gone, I have been with you, and I have cut off all your enemies in front of you. Now I will make you a name like the names of the greatest people on earth.
en.R: I have been with you everywhere you went. I have destroyed all your enemies as you faced them. Now I will make you famous, like the most famous people in the world.

es.L: Y he estado contigo dondequiera que has ido, y he exterminado delante de ti a todos tus enemigos, y te haré un nombre como el nombre de los grandes que [hay] en la tierra.
es.B: Dondequiera que has ido, yo he estado contigo, y he destruido a todos tus enemigos delante de ti. Ahora haré tu nombre como el nombre de los más grandes de la tierra.
es.R: He estado contigo en todos los lugares adonde has ido. He destruido a todos tus enemigos cuando te enfrentaban. Ahora te haré famoso, como las personas más famosas del mundo.

fr.L: Et j’ai été avec toi partout où tu es allé, et j’ai retranché tous tes ennemis devant toi, et je te ferai un nom comme le nom des grands qui [sont] sur la terre.
fr.B: Partout où tu es allé, j’ai été avec toi, et j’ai anéanti tous tes ennemis devant toi. Maintenant, je te ferai un nom pareil au nom des plus grands de la terre.
fr.R: J’ai été avec toi partout où tu es allé. J’ai détruit tous tes ennemis quand tu les affrontais. Maintenant, je vais te rendre célèbre, comme les gens les plus célèbres du monde.

sw.L: Nami nimekuwa pamoja nawe kila ulikokwenda, nami nimewakatilia mbali adui zako wote mbele yako, nami nitakufanyia jina kama jina la wakuu walio duniani.
sw.B: Popote ulipokwenda nimekuwa pamoja nawe, nami nimewaangamiza adui zako wote mbele yako. Sasa nitalifanya jina lako kama majina ya watu wakuu kabisa duniani.
sw.R: Nimekuwa pamoja nawe kila mahali ulipokwenda. Nimewaangamiza adui zako wote ulipokabiliana nao. Sasa nitakufanya kuwa maarufu, kama watu maarufu kuliko wote duniani.

vi.L: Ta đã ở cùng ngươi bất cứ nơi nào ngươi đi, và đã diệt trừ mọi kẻ thù của ngươi khỏi trước mặt ngươi, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho ngươi một danh như danh của những người vĩ đại trên đất.
vi.B: Con đi đâu, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng ở cùng con, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã diệt trừ mọi kẻ thù trước mặt con. Bây giờ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho danh con lớn như danh của những người vĩ đại nhất trên đất.
vi.R: Con đi đâu {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng ở cùng con. Ta đã tiêu diệt mọi kẻ thù khi chúng đối đầu với con. Bây giờ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho con nổi danh như những người nổi tiếng nhất trên thế giới.

ko.L: 그리고 나는 네가 가는 모든 곳에서 너와 함께 있었고, 네 앞에서 너의 모든 원수를 끊어 버렸다. 그리고 내가 땅에 있는 위대한 자들의 이름처럼 너에게 이름을 만들어 주겠다.
ko.B: 네가 어디로 가든지 나는 너와 함께 있었고, 네 앞에서 너의 모든 원수를 없애 버렸다. 이제 나는 네 이름을 세상에서 가장 위대한 사람들의 이름처럼 만들어 주겠다.
ko.R: 나는 네가 가는 곳마다 너와 함께 있었다. 네가 원수들과 맞설 때마다 내가 그들을 모두 없애 버렸다. 이제 나는 너를 세상에서 가장 유명한 사람들처럼 유명하게 만들어 주겠다.

pt.L: E estive contigo em tudo por onde andaste, e eliminei todos os teus inimigos de diante de ti, e farei para ti um nome como o nome dos grandes que [há] na terra.
pt.B: Por onde quer que tenhas andado, eu estive contigo, e eliminei todos os teus inimigos diante de ti. Agora farei o teu nome como o nome dos maiores da terra.
pt.R: Estive contigo em todos os lugares por onde foste. Destruí todos os teus inimigos quando enfrentaste cada um deles. Agora vou te tornar famoso, como as pessoas mais famosas do mundo.

am.L: በሄድክበትም ሁሉ ከአንተ ጋር ነበርኩ፤ ጠላቶችህንም ሁሉ ከፊትህ አጠፋሁ፤ በምድርም እንዳሉት እንደ ታላላቆቹ ስም ስም አደርግልሃለሁ።
am.B: በሄድክበት ሁሉ ከአንተ ጋር ነበርኩ፤ ጠላቶችህንም ሁሉ ከፊትህ አጠፋሁ። አሁንም በምድር ላይ እንዳሉት እንደ ታላላቅ ሰዎች ስም ስም አደርግልሃለሁ።
am.R: በሄድክበት ሁሉ ከአንተ ጋር ነበርኩ። ጠላቶችህን ስትገጥማቸው ሁሉንም አጠፋኋቸው። አሁንም በዓለም ላይ እንዳሉት እንደ ታዋቂዎቹ ሰዎች አንተንም ታዋቂ አደርግሃለሁ።

hi.L: और जहाँ-जहाँ तुम गए, मैं तुम्हारे साथ रहा, और मैंने तुम्हारे सब शत्रुओं को तुम्हारे सामने से नाश किया है, और मैं तुम्हारे लिए एक नाम बनाऊँगा, पृथ्वी पर के बड़े लोगों के नाम के समान।
hi.B: जहाँ कहीं तुम गए, मैं तुम्हारे साथ रहा, और मैंने तुम्हारे सामने से तुम्हारे सब शत्रुओं को मिटा दिया है। अब मैं तुम्हारा नाम पृथ्वी के सबसे बड़े लोगों के नाम के समान करूँगा।
hi.R: तुम जहाँ-जहाँ गए, मैं तुम्हारे साथ रहा। जब तुम्हारे शत्रु तुम्हारे सामने आए, तब मैंने उन सबको नाश कर दिया। अब मैं तुम्हें संसार के सबसे प्रसिद्ध लोगों के समान प्रसिद्ध करूँगा।

ru.L: И {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} был с тобой везде, куда ты ходил, и истребил всех твоих врагов от твоего лица, и сделаю тебе имя, как имя великих, которые на земле.
ru.B: Куда бы ты ни шёл, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} был с тобой и истреблял перед тобой всех твоих врагов. Теперь {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сделаю твоё имя таким же, как имена величайших людей на земле.
ru.R: Я был с тобой везде, куда бы ты ни шёл. Я уничтожил всех твоих врагов, когда ты выходил против них. Теперь {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сделаю тебя знаменитым, как самых знаменитых людей в мире.

uk.L: І Я був з тобою скрізь, куди ти ходив, і винищив усіх твоїх ворогів перед тобою, і зроблю тобі імʼя, як імʼя великих, що [є] на землі.
uk.B: Куди б ти не йшов, Я був з тобою і винищив перед тобою всіх твоїх ворогів. Тепер Я зроблю твоє імʼя таким, як імена найвеличніших людей на землі.
uk.R: Я був з тобою всюди, куди ти йшов. Я знищив усіх твоїх ворогів, коли ти стояв проти них. Тепер Я зроблю тебе славним, як найславетніші люди у світі.

decisions.choice: I have been, I have cut off ... and I will make: from what Yahweh has done to what he will do
alternatives: I have made for you a name
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 7:9. The first verbs tell what Yahweh has already done for David. With "and I will make" the verb form changes to the one used for the future, and the promises begin. Some read this verb and those in verses 9-10 as still telling the past ("I have made you a name"), but the form and the promise in verse 10 favor the future.

decisions.choice: I will make for you a name
decisions.reason: Yahweh made a like promise to Abram: "I will make your name great" (Genesis 12:2). 2 Samuel 7:9 says "a great name"; Chronicles says "a name like the name of the great ones", with the same sense.

decisions.choice: cut off from before you: destroyed as they faced you
decisions.reason: Yahweh removed David's enemies one by one as David met them in battle (11:4-9; 14:8-17).

decisions.choice: Now
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 7:9: Balanced and Readable add "Now" to mark where the past ends and the promises begin (m1).

decisions.choice: make you famous
decisions.reason: Readable puts "a name" in plain words.

decisions.choice: farei o teu nome como o nome dos maiores da terra (B)
decisions.reason: Chronicles has no "great" before "name" (m2), so Balanced does not use the "tornarei grande o teu nome" of 2 Samuel 7:9 in Portuguese; the rest of the verse keeps that wording.

decisions.choice: parallel 2 Samuel 7:9 copied, without "ታላቅ" (great) before "name"
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "a name like the name of the great ones" without Samuel's "great name"; Readable is as in Samuel, whose English Readable is the same.

decisions.choice: "сделаю тебе имя", without "великое"
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "a name" where 2 Samuel 7:9 has "a great name"; the comparison with the great ones of the earth stays.

source.text: וְשַׂמְתִּ֣י מָ֠קוֹם לְעַמִּ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל וּנְטַעְתִּ֨יהוּ֙ וְשָׁכַ֣ן תַּחְתָּ֔יו וְלֹ֥א יִרְגַּ֖ז ע֑וֹד וְלֹא־יוֹסִ֤יפוּ בְנֵי־עַוְלָה֙ לְבַלֹּת֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר בָּרִאשׁוֹנָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and I will plant it, and it will dwell in its place and not be disturbed again; and not will add sons of injustice to wear it out as at the first,

en.L: And I will appoint a place for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel, and I will plant it, and it will dwell in its own place and not be disturbed again; and the sons of wickedness will not again wear it down as at the first,
en.B: I will appoint a place for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel and plant them there, so that they may live in their own place and not be troubled anymore. Wicked people will no longer wear them down as they did at the beginning,
en.R: I will choose a place for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel. I will plant them there like a tree, so that they can live in their own land and not be afraid anymore. Evil people will not crush them again the way they did before.

es.L: Y señalaré un lugar para {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel, y lo plantaré, y habitará en su propio lugar y no será perturbado más; y los hijos de iniquidad no volverán a desgastarlo como al principio,
es.B: Señalaré un lugar para {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel y los plantaré allí, para que vivan en su propio lugar y no sean molestados nunca más. La gente malvada ya no los desgastará como lo hizo al principio,
es.R: Escogeré un lugar para {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel. Los plantaré allí como a un árbol, para que puedan vivir en su propia tierra y ya no tengan miedo. La gente malvada no volverá a aplastarlos como antes.

fr.L: Et je fixerai un lieu pour {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël, et je le planterai, et il habitera à sa place et ne sera plus troublé ; et les fils d’iniquité ne recommenceront plus à l’user comme au commencement,
fr.B: Je fixerai un lieu pour {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël et je l’y planterai, pour qu’il habite chez lui et ne soit plus inquiété. Les méchants ne l’useront plus comme ils l’ont fait au début,
fr.R: Je choisirai un endroit pour {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël. Je l’y planterai comme un arbre, pour qu’il puisse vivre dans son propre pays sans avoir peur. Les méchants ne l’écraseront plus comme avant.

sw.L: Nami nitawawekea watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli mahali, nami nitawapanda, nao watakaa mahali pao wenyewe wasisumbuliwe tena; wala wana wa uovu hawataongeza kuwadhoofisha kama hapo kwanza,
sw.B: Nitawachagulia watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli mahali na kuwapanda huko, ili wakae mahali pao wenyewe wasisumbuliwe tena. Watu waovu hawatawadhoofisha tena kama walivyofanya hapo mwanzo,
sw.R: Nitawachagulia watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli mahali. Nitawapanda huko kama mti, ili waishi katika nchi yao wenyewe wasiogope tena. Watu waovu hawatawaponda tena kama walivyofanya zamani.

vi.L: Ta sẽ định một chỗ cho dân Y-sơ-ra-ên của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và sẽ trồng nó, để nó ở tại chỗ của mình và không còn bị khuấy rối nữa; và con cái gian ác sẽ không còn hà hiếp nó như thuở trước,
vi.B: Ta sẽ định một chỗ cho dân Y-sơ-ra-ên của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và trồng họ tại đó, để họ được sống ở chỗ của mình và không còn bị quấy nhiễu nữa. Kẻ gian ác sẽ không còn áp bức họ như thuở ban đầu,
vi.R: Ta sẽ chọn một chỗ cho dân Y-sơ-ra-ên của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Ta sẽ trồng họ ở đó như trồng một cây, để họ được sống trong xứ của mình và không còn phải sợ hãi nữa. Kẻ ác sẽ không còn làm hại họ như trước kia nữa.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 내 백성 이스라엘을 위하여 한 곳을 정하고 그들을 심어서, 그들이 자기 곳에 살며 다시는 흔들리지 않게 하겠다. 그리고 악한 자들이 처음처럼 다시는 그들을 쇠하게 하지 못할 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 내 백성 이스라엘이 살 곳을 정하고 그들을 거기에 심어, 그들이 자기 땅에서 살며 다시는 불안에 떨지 않게 하겠다. 악한 자들이 처음처럼 다시는 그들을 지치게 하지 못할 것이다.
ko.R: 나는 내 백성 이스라엘을 위해 한 곳을 정하겠다. 나무를 심듯이 그들을 거기에 심어서, 그들이 자기 땅에서 살며 더 이상 두려워하지 않게 하겠다. 악한 사람들이 전처럼 다시는 그들을 짓밟지 못할 것이다.

pt.L: E designarei um lugar para o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo Israel, e o plantarei, e ele habitará no seu lugar e não será mais perturbado; e os filhos da maldade não tornarão a desgastá-lo como no princípio,
pt.B: Designarei um lugar para o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo Israel e o plantarei ali, para que viva no seu próprio lugar e não seja mais perturbado. Os perversos não voltarão a desgastá-lo como fizeram no princípio,
pt.R: Vou escolher um lugar para o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo Israel. Vou plantá-lo ali como uma árvore, para que ele possa viver na sua própria terra e não tenha mais medo. Gente má não vai mais esmagá-lo como antes.

am.L: ለሕዝቤም ለእስራኤል ስፍራ አዘጋጃለሁ፤ እተክለዋለሁም፤ በስፍራውም ይቀመጣል፤ ከእንግዲህም አይናወጥም፤ የዓመፅ ልጆችም እንደ ቀድሞው ዳግመኛ አያደክሙትም፤
am.B: ለሕዝቤ ለእስራኤል ስፍራ አዘጋጃለሁ፤ በገዛ ስፍራቸው እንዲኖሩና ከእንግዲህ እንዳይታወኩ በዚያ እተክላቸዋለሁ። ክፉ ሰዎችም እንደ ቀድሞው ዳግመኛ አያደክሟቸውም፤
am.R: ለሕዝቤ ለእስራኤል ስፍራ እመርጣለሁ። በገዛ ምድራቸው እንዲኖሩና ከእንግዲህ እንዳይፈሩ በዚያ እንደ ዛፍ እተክላቸዋለሁ። ክፉ ሰዎችም እንደ ቀድሞው ዳግመኛ አያደቅቋቸውም።

hi.L: और मैं अपनी प्रजा इस्राएल के लिए एक स्थान ठहराऊँगा, और उसे रोपूँगा, और वह अपने ही स्थान में बसेगा और फिर कभी विचलित न होगा; और दुष्टता के पुत्र उसे फिर क्षीण न करेंगे, जैसा पहले [होता था],
hi.B: मैं अपनी प्रजा इस्राएल के लिए एक स्थान ठहराऊँगा और उन्हें वहाँ रोपूँगा, ताकि वे अपने ही स्थान में बसे रहें और फिर कभी व्याकुल न किए जाएँ। दुष्ट लोग उन्हें फिर कुचलकर कमज़ोर नहीं करेंगे, जैसे आरंभ में करते थे,
hi.R: मैं अपनी प्रजा इस्राएल के लिए एक स्थान चुनूँगा। मैं उन्हें वहाँ पेड़ की तरह रोपूँगा, ताकि वे अपने ही देश में रहें और फिर कभी न डरें। दुष्ट लोग उन्हें फिर नहीं कुचलेंगे, जैसे पहले कुचलते थे।

ru.L: И {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} назначу место {{deity_pronoun:моему|Моему}} народу Израилю, и посажу его, и он будет жить на своём месте и больше не будет тревожим; и сыны неправды больше не будут изнурять его, как прежде,
ru.B: Я назначу место {{deity_pronoun:моему|Моему}} народу Израилю и посажу их там, чтобы они жили на своём месте и больше не знали тревог. Злодеи больше не будут изнурять их, как было вначале,
ru.R: Я выберу место для {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} народа Израиля. Я посажу их там, как дерево, чтобы они жили в своей земле и больше ничего не боялись. Злые люди больше не будут угнетать их, как раньше.

uk.L: І Я визначу місце для {{deity_pronoun:мого|Мого}} народу Ізраїлю, і посаджу його, і він житиме на своєму місці, і більше не тривожитиметься; і сини беззаконня більше не виснажуватимуть його, як спочатку,
uk.B: Я визначу місце для {{deity_pronoun:мого|Мого}} народу Ізраїлю і посаджу їх там, щоб вони жили на своєму місці й більше не зазнавали тривоги. Лихі люди вже не виснажуватимуть їх, як було на початку,
uk.R: Я виберу місце для {{deity_pronoun:мого|Мого}} народу Ізраїлю. Я посаджу їх там, як дерево, щоб вони жили у своїй землі й більше не боялися. Лихі люди вже не гнобитимуть їх, як колись.

decisions.choice: a place: a land where Israel can live in safety
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 7:10. The place is the land where Yahweh will plant his people. The same word is used in Deuteronomy for the place Yahweh will choose for his name (Deuteronomy 12:5), and that may be heard here too; but the words "plant" and "dwell" point to the land.

decisions.choice: I will plant it: settle Israel for good
decisions.reason: Moses' song says Yahweh would plant his people on the mountain of his inheritance (Exodus 15:17; compare Psalm 44:3; 80:9). A planted people is rooted and not moved again.

decisions.choice: sons of wickedness: violent, unjust people
decisions.reason: "Sons of" a quality means people marked by it. Here it means oppressors, like those who afflicted Israel in Egypt and in the time of the judges. The sentence goes on into verse 10: "as at the first, and from the days I appointed judges".

decisions.choice: to wear it down
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 7:10 has "to afflict it"; Chronicles has a verb that means to wear out or use up, as clothing wears out (Deuteronomy 8:4). It also says "for my people Israel" for "for my people, for Israel". The sense is the same: Israel will no longer be worn down by oppressors.

decisions.choice: plant them there like a tree; not be afraid
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 7:10: Readable makes the picture in "plant" plain and says what being "disturbed" means for a people: living in fear. It ends the sentence here, and verse 10 picks it up.

decisions.choice: kuwadhoofisha
decisions.reason: Chronicles has a verb meaning "wear out" where 2 Samuel 7:10 has "afflict"; Swahili "kudhoofisha" (to wear down, weaken) follows Chronicles.

decisions.choice: verse 9 closed as a sentence; verse 10 restates the time as its own sentence
decisions.reason: As 2 Samuel 7:10-11 in Korean: Korean puts the time clause before the verb, so to keep each verse's words under its number the Korean closes verse 9.

decisions.choice: desgastá-lo (L, B); esmagá-lo (R)
decisions.reason: Chronicles' verb means to wear out (m4), where 2 Samuel 7:10 has "oprimir"; Portuguese "desgastar" says it at Literal and Balanced, and Readable follows the English "crush". The rest keeps the wording of 2 Samuel 7:10.

decisions.choice: parallel 2 Samuel 7:10 copied, with "አያደክሙትም" / "አያደቅቋቸውም" (wear down) for Samuel's "afflict"
decisions.reason: Chronicles has another verb, "to wear out", where Samuel has "to afflict"; the rest of the Hebrew is the same.

decisions.choice: "क्षीण न करेंगे" (Literal), "कुचलकर कमज़ोर नहीं करेंगे" (Balanced), "नहीं कुचलेंगे" (Readable)
decisions.reason: Chronicles has a different verb here, "wear down" (meaning m4), where 2 Samuel 7:10 has "afflict", so the Hindi changes the verb and keeps the rest of the Samuel wording, including Literal's bracketed "[होता था]" before the verse marker.

decisions.choice: "изнурять" for "wear down"
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 7:10 has "afflict"; the Chronicles verb is to wear out (m4), so Literal and Balanced say "изнурять".

source.text: וּלְמִיָּמִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוִּ֤יתִי שֹֽׁפְטִים֙ עַל־עַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְהִכְנַ֖עְתִּי אֶת־כָּל־אוֹיְבֶ֑יךָ וָאַגִּ֣ד לָ֔ךְ וּבַ֖יִת יִֽבְנֶה־לְּךָ֥ יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: and from [the] days that I appointed judges over my people Israel. And I will subdue all your enemies. And I declare to you that a house will build for you Yahweh.

en.L: and from the days that I appointed judges over {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel. And I will subdue all your enemies. And I declare to you that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will build a house for you.
en.B: ever since the time I set judges over {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel. I will also bring all your enemies low. And I declare to you that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will build you a house.
en.R: They did that from the time I put judges over {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel. And I will defeat all your enemies. I tell you now that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will build a house for you, a family of kings who will come after you.

es.L: y desde los días en que puse jueces sobre {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel. Y someteré a todos tus enemigos. Y te declaro que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te edificará una casa.
es.B: desde el tiempo en que puse jueces sobre {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel. También humillaré a todos tus enemigos. Y te declaro que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te edificará una casa.
es.R: Lo hicieron desde el tiempo en que puse jueces sobre {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel. Y yo derrotaré a todos tus enemigos. Ahora te digo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te edificará una casa, una familia de reyes que vendrán después de ti.

fr.L: et depuis les jours où j’ai établi des juges sur {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël. Et j’humilierai tous tes ennemis. Et je t’annonce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te bâtira une maison.
fr.B: depuis le temps où j’ai établi des juges sur {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël. J’abaisserai aussi tous tes ennemis. Et je te déclare que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te bâtira une maison.
fr.R: Ils l’ont fait depuis l’époque où j’ai établi des juges sur {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël. Et je vaincrai tous tes ennemis. Maintenant, je te le dis : {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te bâtira une maison, une famille de rois qui viendront après toi.

sw.L: na tangu siku zile nilipoweka waamuzi juu ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli. Nami nitawashinda adui zako wote. Nami nakutangazia kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakujengea nyumba.
sw.B: tangu wakati nilipoweka waamuzi juu ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli. Nami nitawanyenyekesha adui zako wote. Nami nakutangazia kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakujengea nyumba.
sw.R: Walifanya hivyo tangu wakati nilipoweka waamuzi juu ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli. Nami nitawashinda adui zako wote. Nakuambia sasa kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakujengea nyumba, yaani ukoo wa wafalme watakaokufuata.

vi.L: và từ những ngày {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} lập các quan xét trên dân Y-sơ-ra-ên của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Ta sẽ hạ mọi kẻ thù của ngươi xuống. Và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} báo cho ngươi biết rằng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ xây cho ngươi một nhà.
vi.B: kể từ khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} lập các quan xét trên dân Y-sơ-ra-ên của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Ta cũng sẽ hạ mọi kẻ thù của con xuống. Và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} báo cho con biết rằng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ xây cho con một nhà.
vi.R: Chúng đã làm như vậy từ thời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} lập các thủ lĩnh trên dân Y-sơ-ra-ên của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Ta sẽ đánh bại mọi kẻ thù của con. Bây giờ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cho con biết rằng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ xây cho con một nhà, tức là một dòng dõi các vua nối tiếp con.

ko.L: 내가 내 백성 이스라엘 위에 사사들을 세운 날부터 [그러했다]. 그리고 내가 너의 모든 원수를 굴복시키겠다. 그리고 내가 너에게 선언한다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너를 위하여 집을 세우실 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 내 백성 이스라엘 위에 사사들을 세운 때부터 그러했다. 나는 또 너의 모든 원수를 낮추겠다. 내가 너에게 선언한다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 너를 위하여 한 집안을 세워 주겠다.
ko.R: 내가 내 백성 이스라엘 위에 사사들을 세운 때부터 그들은 그렇게 했다. 그리고 나는 너의 모든 원수를 무찌르겠다. 이제 내가 너에게 말한다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 너를 위해 한 집안을 세워 주겠다. 네 뒤를 이어 왕이 될 자손들을 주겠다.

pt.L: e desde os dias em que ordenei juízes sobre o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo Israel. E subjugarei todos os teus inimigos. E eu te declaro que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} te edificará uma casa.
pt.B: desde o tempo em que estabeleci juízes sobre o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo Israel. Também humilharei todos os teus inimigos. E eu te declaro que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} te construirá uma casa.
pt.R: Eles fizeram isso desde o tempo em que coloquei juízes sobre o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo Israel. E eu vou derrotar todos os teus inimigos. Eu te digo agora que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} vai construir para ti uma casa, uma família de reis que virão depois de ti.

am.L: በሕዝቤም በእስራኤል ላይ መሳፍንትን ካዘዝሁበት ዘመን ጀምሮ [እንዳደረጉት]። ጠላቶችህንም ሁሉ አዋርዳለሁ። ቤትም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንደሚሠራልህ እነግርሃለሁ።
am.B: በሕዝቤ በእስራኤል ላይ መሳፍንትን ከሾምኩበት ጊዜ ጀምሮ እንዳደረጉት አያደርጉም። ጠላቶችህንም ሁሉ አዋርዳለሁ። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ቤት እንደሚሠራልህ እነግርሃለሁ።
am.R: ይህንም ያደረጉት በሕዝቤ በእስራኤል ላይ መሪዎችን ካስቀመጥኩበት ጊዜ ጀምሮ ነበር። ጠላቶችህንም ሁሉ ድል አደርግልሃለሁ። አሁንም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ቤት እንደሚሠራልህ፣ ከአንተም በኋላ የሚነግሡ ነገሥታትን እንደሚሰጥህ እነግርሃለሁ።

hi.L: और जैसा उन दिनों से [होता आया] जब मैंने अपनी प्रजा इस्राएल पर न्यायी ठहराए थे। और मैं तुम्हारे सब शत्रुओं को नीचा करूँगा। और मैं तुम्हें बताता हूँ कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे लिए एक घर बनाएँगे।
hi.B: जैसे वे उस समय से करते आए जब मैंने अपनी प्रजा इस्राएल पर न्यायी ठहराए थे। मैं तुम्हारे सब शत्रुओं को भी नीचा करूँगा। और मैं तुमसे यह घोषणा करता हूँ कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे लिए एक घराना बनाएँगे।
hi.R: वे उस समय से ऐसा करते आए जब मैंने अपनी प्रजा इस्राएल पर न्यायी ठहराए थे। और मैं तुम्हारे सब शत्रुओं को हरा दूँगा। मैं तुम्हें अभी बताता हूँ कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे लिए एक घर बनाएँगे, यानी राजाओं का एक वंश जो तुम्हारे बाद आएगा।

ru.L: и со дней, когда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} поставил судей над {{deity_pronoun:моим|Моим}} народом Израилем. И {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} смирю всех твоих врагов. И возвещаю тебе, что дом построит тебе {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.
ru.B: с тех самых пор, как {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} поставил судей над {{deity_pronoun:моим|Моим}} народом Израилем. И {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} смирю всех твоих врагов. И {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} возвещаю тебе, что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} построит тебе дом.
ru.R: Так было с того времени, когда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} поставил судей над {{deity_pronoun:моим|Моим}} народом Израилем. А всех твоих врагов {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} одолею. И теперь {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} говорю тебе, что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} построит тебе дом — род царей, которые будут после тебя.

uk.L: і від днів, коли Я поставив суддів над {{deity_pronoun:моїм|Моїм}} народом Ізраїлем. І Я впокорю всіх твоїх ворогів. І звіщаю тобі, що {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} збудує тобі дім.
uk.B: відтоді, як Я поставив суддів над {{deity_pronoun:моїм|Моїм}} народом Ізраїлем. Я також упокорю всіх твоїх ворогів. І звіщаю тобі, що {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} збудує тобі дім.
uk.R: Вони робили так відтоді, як Я поставив суддів над {{deity_pronoun:моїм|Моїм}} народом Ізраїлем. І Я переможу всіх твоїх ворогів. Кажу тобі тепер, що {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} збудує тобі дім, рід царів, які прийдуть після тебе.

decisions.choice: a house: a family line of kings
decisions.reason: Here the play on the word turns. David wanted to build God a house of cedar; Yahweh will build David a house of a different kind, a family of descendants who will sit on his throne (verses 11-14). Chronicles uses the verb "build" here, where 2 Samuel 7:11 has "make": the house David will not build for Yahweh (verse 4), Yahweh builds for him.

decisions.choice: I will subdue all your enemies; I declare to you; build
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 7:11 says "I will give you rest from all your enemies"; Chronicles says "I will subdue all your enemies". In Chronicles David's victories follow at once (18:1, where the same verb is used of the Philistines), and the rest is kept for Solomon (22:9). Samuel then has "Yahweh declares to you that Yahweh will make a house for you"; Chronicles has "I declare to you that Yahweh will build a house for you". It also has "from the days" for "from the day".

decisions.choice: subdue: humble, bring low
decisions.reason: The verb means to bring an enemy down so that he submits (Judges 4:23; 1 Samuel 7:13).

decisions.choice: I declare to you: the announcement is made now
decisions.reason: The verb form usually tells something past, "and I told you". Here it is taken as the solemn announcement Yahweh makes in this very message. Some read it "I have told you", looking back to earlier promises to David.

decisions.choice: a house, a family of kings who will come after you
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 7:11: Readable keeps the word "house" for the play on it and adds what it means here (m1). It also starts a new sentence that links back to the oppression of verse 9.

decisions.choice: bring low (Balanced); defeat (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced says "bring low", what the verb pictures (m3), and Readable says "defeat", for the less common "subdue".

decisions.choice: nitawashinda / nitawanyenyekesha adui zako; atakujengea nyumba
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "I will subdue your enemies" and "will build you a house" where 2 Samuel 7:11 has "give you rest" and "make you a house"; the Swahili follows Chronicles, keeping the play on "build" with verse 4.

decisions.choice: God names himself without the honorific at Balanced and Readable ("{{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 ... 세워 주겠다")
decisions.reason: As 2 Samuel 7:11 in Korean: a speaker does not honor himself, so when God speaks of himself by name Balanced and Readable drop the honorific; Literal keeps the narrator's honorific.

decisions.choice: subjugarei (L), humilharei (B), vou derrotar (R); te edificará (L) / construirá (B, R) uma casa
decisions.reason: Chronicles says "subdue" where 2 Samuel 7:11 has "give you rest" (m2, m3), and "build" where Samuel has "make", so Portuguese uses the verb of verses 4 and 12 ("edificar" at Literal, "construir" at Balanced and Readable), and the play on "casa" is heard. Readable adds what the house is, as 2 Samuel 7:11 does at Readable.

decisions.choice: parallel 2 Samuel 7:11: the first clause kept; "ጠላቶችህንም ሁሉ አዋርዳለሁ" (I will subdue) and "እነግርሃለሁ" (I declare) follow Chronicles
decisions.reason: Where Samuel has "I will give you rest from all your enemies" and "the LORD declares to you that the LORD will make you a house", Chronicles has "I will subdue all your enemies" and "I declare to you that the LORD will build you a house", so the name appears once.

decisions.choice: "एक घर" (Literal); "एक घराना" (Balanced); "एक घर, यानी राजाओं का एक वंश" (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 7:11: "house" here is a line of kings (meaning m1). God speaks in the first person ("मैं तुम्हें बताता हूँ") and then of himself by name, as the Hebrew does.

decisions.choice: "смирю" (Literal, Balanced), "одолею" (Readable); "построит тебе дом"
decisions.reason: Where 2 Samuel 7:11 has "I will give you rest" and "will make you a house", Chronicles has "I will subdue" and "will build" (m2, m3).

decisions.choice: "дім" kept for both the temple and David's royal line
decisions.reason: The promise plays on the one word "house"; Literal and Bridge keep "дім" for both, and the Reader level adds "рід царів" as the English adds "a family of kings".
